name: Pixtuoid Office (unofficial)
description: Opens a floating pixel-art office on Windows where your local Orca agents, their orchestrated workers and their subagents appear as coworkers.

screenshots.alt: Pixel-art office: Claude Code agents with a Codex and an Antigravity worker, each labelled with its provider, under their Claude parent.
screenshots.caption: Cross-provider workers under their Claude Code parent
